Pilot: Application for a PhD programme
Piloting a new application form.
In 2026 we are piloting a new application form for PhD-candidates at the following departments and faculties:
Faculty of Humanities (all departments)
Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences (all departments)
Department of Computer Science
Department of Mathematical Sciences
Department of Information Security and Communication Technology
Only candidates connected to these faculties and departments may use the form linked on this page. If you are connected to another faculty/department, please find your form here:
PhD Forms - NTNU
On this webpage, you will find information and guidance on how to submit the form for admission to a PhD programme at NTNU. The form functions slightly differently depending on whether or not you are employed at NTNU. The coursework component and project description must be approved by your main supervisor prior to submission.
For PhD Candidates employed at NTNU
You are already employed in a PhD research fellow position at NTNU. Upon employment, you were granted conditional admission to a PhD programme, provided that you later submit the full research proposal, a plan for the coursework component, and an agreement on academic supervision through this form.
Please note that some faculties have their own templates for the research proposal: Project description - PhD
The following documents must be prepared before you start:
Agreement on academic supervision - the agreement will be assessed as part of your application and you will receive the agreement for signing once the content has been approved. Go through the agreement together with your supervisor (PDF should be downloaded before filling out)
A complete research proposal, including:
research topic
research questions
theory and methodology
how you will address research ethics and legal considerations in the project
risk assessment of the project
timeline for the doctoral work, including plans for dissemination and any stays at other institutions
For External Applicants (not employed as a PhD research fellow at NTNU)
For external applicants, the form serves as an application for admission to a PhD programme. You must attach all required documentation, including a funding agreement and a research proposal. Please note that some faculties have their own templates for the research proposal: Project description - PhD
The following documents must be prepared before you start:
Agreement on academic supervision - the agreement will be assessed as part of your application and you will receive the agreement for signing once the content has been approved. Go through the agreement together with your supervisor. (PDF should be downloaded before filling out)
Agreement with external party signed by you and your employer
A complete research proposal, including:
research topic
research questions
theory and methodology
how you will address research ethics and legal considerations in the project
risk assessment of the project
timeline for the doctoral work, including plans for dissemination and any stays at other institutions
If your education is not from a Norwegian public institution, you must also upload:
Documentation of education: degree certificates, diploma supplement, and translations if the documents are written in languages other than English or Scandinavian languages.
In addition, you must provide:
an overview of the courses you plan to take, and
a plan for stays at NTNU during the doctoral period approved by main supervisor
Complete the admission form
Once all documents are ready, you may submit your application via our digital form:
👉 Complete the online application form for admission to a PhD programme
Applications are processed on an ongoing basis.
